name: Music Cognition
notes: Six courses. Offered through the Music and Sound Initiative; satisfies the natural sciences division of the Rochester Curriculum.
DEPARTMENT-CODE TRANSLATION: the Music and Sound Initiative page writes 'BCS' and 'MUR' where the registrar's catalog uses BCSC and MUSC. All codes here are translated.
No more than two courses may overlap with the student's major or another minor.
Eastman School music theory courses are acceptable in place of MUSC 111 or MUSC 112.

requirementGroups.label: Required courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Music Cognition Minor ... All three of the following: BCS 260: Music and the Mind; MUR 111: Theory I; MUR 112: Theory II

requirementGroups.label: One cognitive-science foundation course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one of the following: BCS 110: Neural Foundations of Behavior; BCS 111: Foundations of Cognitive Science

requirementGroups.label: Two electives
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: And two of the following: BCS 152: Language and Psycholinguistics; BCS 153: Cognition; BCS 221: Auditory Perception; BCS 265: Language and the Brain
